text:
sam: Heads up — RFC follow-up: proposal for a lightweight "graceful-degrade" proxy layer to handle canary -> fallback arbitration. Want a quick sync.

maria: Sketch? Major tradeoffs? Specifically session-affinity vs stateless hedging?

sam: High level: keep routing decision in the edge proxy (fast path), but push long-running rollout metrics + final arbitration into control-plane. Proxy handles token-aware sampling, fast circuit-breaks, and soft fallbacks; control-plane manages policy, confidence scoring, and irreversible rollbacks.

jon: Concern: edge proxy coupling increases blast radius. Can we make proxy pluggable with a thin gRPC contract?

sam: Yes — plan is a minimal gRPC interface: DecideRoute(request) -> {variant, ttl_ms, fallback_hint}. Example proto:
```proto
service Router {
  rpc DecideRoute(DecideRequest) returns (DecideReply);
}
message DecideRequest { string tenant_id = 1; string session_id = 2; int32 tokens = 3; }
message DecideReply { string variant = 1; int32 ttl_ms = 2; string fallback_hint = 3; float confidence = 4; }
```

kim: Telemetry question: what signals drive auto-fallback? p99 latency? error-rate? online-quality regressions vs eval set?

maria: Also want a safe-mode: when fallback is triggered, proxy should keep a tiny % (eg 1-5%) of traffic to the canary for continued signal collection.

sam: Autoswitch heuristics = weighted combo: p99 latency (30s window), request error-rate (5m), and online regression score on sentinel prompts. Control-plane computes confidence [0..1]. If confidence < 0.8 -> soft-fallback (mirror + 5% traffic). If confidence >= 0.8 -> hard-fallback (route -> fallback variant).

jon: Implementation notes: decisions must be idempotent for retries. Policy blobs should be versioned and cached with TTL to avoid zombie configs on proxies.

sam: Agreed. Rollbacks: allow both manual and auto. Auto only when sustained signal (eg >2 minutes and >threshold). Teams can opt-out per-policy.

kim: Runbook quick snippet:
- If auto-fallback triggers: check fallback_reason, inspect p99 & regression graphs
- If confidence spikes back under threshold, promote rollback else escalate to oncall
- Use `redwood rollback <policy>` as manual override

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary-policy v1.2 -> proxies (3/12) done :rocket:

maria: Action items: 1) proto PR for router contract 2) control-plane policy CRD + versioning 3) dashboard mockups for confidence & sentinel prompts. I'll file issues.

sam: Thanks — filing issues now. Ping me for reviews.
